theorems.name: Submission.ts_unit_ball_plane_cutoff_approx
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (P : Submodule ℝ (Ambient n ℓ)), Module.finrank ℝ P = n → (∀ a : ℝ, a < omega n → ∃ g : C_c(Ambient n ℓ, ℝ), (∀ y : Ambient n ℓ, g y ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ y : Ambient n ℓ, 1 < ‖y‖ → g y ≤ 0) ∧ a < ∫ y in (P : Set (Ambient n ℓ)), g y ∂μHE[n]) ∧ (∀ b : ℝ, omega n < b → ∃ h : C_c(Ambient n ℓ, ℝ), (∀ y : Ambient n ℓ, 0 ≤ h y) ∧ (∀ y : Ambient n ℓ, ‖y‖ ≤ 1 → 1 ≤ h y) ∧ ∫ y in (P : Set (Ambient n ℓ)), h y ∂μHE[n] < b)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
